preconditions.description: The number of months n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
The length of the list a is equal to the ceiling of n/2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each income ai in the list a is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
The income x for the last ⌊n/2⌋ months is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (1 <= return_value <= n and all(sum(a[i:i+return_value]) + x * (return_value - len(a[i:i+return_value])) > 0 for i in range(n - return_value + 1)))
postconditions.description: The return value is either -1 or a valid k such that for each k consecutive months, the total income is a profit.
